_meta.name: factor_analysis
_meta.description: Exploratory factor analysis of three measures on experiment.pulse (revenue_before, revenue, session_minutes): one common factor extracted by minres (the default; params.extraction "principal_axis" iterates principal axes instead, and "ml" fits by maximum likelihood, adding the likelihood chi-square, TLI, RMSEA and BIC) from the members' correlation matrix. The primary is the members x factors loadings (column F1); vectors carry each member's communality and uniqueness and the variance the factor accounts for; scalars the root-mean-square residual, the empirical residual chi-square (a residual size, not a likelihood test; df 0 here, so its p is null), KMO, Bartlett's sphericity test, the fit's iterations and convergence and the factor count. Set params.factors to k (or the default "kaiser") and params.rotation to varimax, promax or oblimin on a longer battery: two factors need at least five members. Here session_minutes shares almost nothing with the revenue pair, so the one-factor fit fails: revenue's uniqueness falls below 0 (about -0.90), PULSE_MATRIX_HEYWOOD says so and keeps the loadings as fitted, and minres stops at its 200-iteration cap (PULSE_MATRIX_NOT_CONVERGED). Read it as what a failed fit looks like; 14_rotations.json fits a real two-factor battery. Streamable and mergeable.
